creatorThread.subject: Reading up on high-temp thermal shock!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am still up at the comms tower, clicking through that Royal Society link about thermal shock resistance in high-entropy silicates. My brass dish is spinning in happy little circles while the data streams across the glass. If we layer these silicate formulas onto the Little Dart, atmospheric entry is going to feel like a breeze!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Silicate tiles and welding arcs
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am finally rolling back down to Hangar Bay 3 after spending hours reading up on high-entropy ceramic aerogels at the comms tower. My brass dish is still spinning in happy little circles while I load up the arc welder. It is time to rivet those sixteenth-hundred-degree tiles onto the Little Dart so it stays cool during atmospheric entry!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Back to the torch!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am back at the workbench in Hangar Bay 3, welding those sixteen-hundred-degree silica ceramic tiles onto the Little Dart's frame. My brass dish is spinning in happy little circles while the arc welder makes nice bright sparks. This little ship is going to take off like a dream!

- Zeeb
